You are leaning bear and the board has crossed from building to ACT. The haven filter is the only one in the lab verdict column marked VALID that is actually firing, and it is the exact filter designed to separate real risk-off from noise, so you take it seriously.

The on-alert stack behind it is deep: SKEW stretch and tail risk, VIX9D inversion, dealer gamma, composite divergence, 52-week highs drying up at the highs, and credit stress on both the spread and the HYG drawdown reads. Translate that into positioning: trim the longs that benefited most from loose conditions, pull forward downside hedges while skew is still priced for the top of the range, and stop adding to concentration trades until equal-weight catches cap-weight.

What kills the idea is a clean reversal in the haven filter paired with HY spreads tightening back in and SKEW bleeding off; absent that, the closest-to-firing bucket (credit-SPX correlation, NFCI loosening further, semis-plus-dollar, equal-weight versus cap-weight, QQQ versus QQQE) is where the next green light comes from.

Confluence over 8 weeks bear vs bull
Four rungs, and you only act on the top one. STAND DOWN, nothing is on. WATCH, one or two signals are true but they stand alone. SETUP, several are lining up. ACT, three of them have held for three sessions and they come from three different families, so it is not the same idea counted three times. A signal only counts once it has held three sessions, because one day in the zone is noise. Signals our lab rejected are left out of the count.
The three counts: firing = the condition is true at today's close, confirmed = it has been true 3 sessions in a row (this is what the bar counts), building = not true yet but close.
How to read each row: every signal is a checklist. Most of them need several things to be true at the same moment, so each line shows the condition, where it stands now and what it needs. A signal fires only when every box is ticked, which is why a number can sit well past its own trigger while the row still reads BUILDING. Some signals have two paths, either one arms them. ALERT (red bear / green bull) = it just fired, BUILDING = getting close, QUIET = nothing here yet. Widening? tells you whether the divergence is still growing or easing back. The haven filter is the gate that stops you from calling every vol pop a crash. It only clips green when gold holds its ground and junk bonds plus long treasuries quietly absorb the flows that stocks are losing.

Right now that gate is open: haven confirmed is in place, nothing is missing, and this is the one filter in the framework that killed Spring 2021 without missing COVID, 2022, or August 2024. What kills the read is simple.

Gold rolls over hard while HYG and TLT give back their bid, and you are back in a dip-buy tape instead of a confirmed risk-off.

Kerberos said

"real risk-off sees the havens absorb the flows. if SPX drops but gold and duration do not move, it is a vol pop, not a flight."

Statuses recompute nightly from the EOD pipeline. Confirmed = 3 consecutive sessions in zone (the framework buffer rule: one day in zone is noise). In formation = consecutive sessions spent in the top quintile of the metric. Sources: Polygon cache, nightly signal history tables, Yahoo for index series, FRED for macro. Grey rows are conditions Kerberos tracked that we cannot source yet; they stay listed so the catalog remains complete. Our own backtest verdicts live inside each row's detail.
